changeSet.sql: with aktuelle as ( select inhalt from konfiguration_version order by version desc limit 1 ), naechste as ( select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 as version from konfiguration_version ), abbild as ( select n.version, a.inhalt || jsonb_build_object('version', n.version, 'kiTexte', ( select jsonb_build_object('rolle', t.rolle, 'feldregeln', t.feldregeln, 'kiFreigegeben', t.ki_freigegeben) from ki_texte t where t.id = 1)) as inhalt from aktuelle a, naechste n where (a.inhalt -> 'kiTexte') is null ) insert into konfiguration_version (version, wer, grund, quelle, inhalt, sha256) select version, 'system:migration', null, 'MIGRATION', inhalt, encode(sha256(convert_to(inhalt::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') from abbild where exists (select 1 from dokumentart);
